gate: statement-checked challenge frozen before proof search

G-filter.display: ∀ x0 : List(Box), ∀ x1 : Atom, keepAtom(x0, x1) = list_filter(x0, fun x2 => (decide(x2.atom.tone = x1.tone) && decide(x2.atom.n = x1.n)))

G-fold.display: ∀ x0 : List(Box), coldTotal(x0) = list_foldl(x0, 0, fun x1 x2 => if decide(x2.atom.tone = Tone.cold) then (x1 + x2.atom.n) else x1)

G-map.display: ∀ x0 : List(Box), raiseBoxes(x0) = list_map(x0, fun x1 => Box(Atom(x1.atom.tone, (x1.atom.n + 1)), x1.live))
